title: Delete on a tier with customers that priced nothing is blocked too
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View' and 'Customers — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on tier A for Part Sales only.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Open tier A's three-dot menu on the Tiers list.
  3. Click Delete.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Tier A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Delete can be clicked (not grayed).

Step 3:

  • The blocked dialog opens, listing customer A with Part Sales only.
  • Tier A is not deleted.
